title: Vision Summit 2026: Showcasing the Future of Semiconductor Innovation
description:
RRP Electronics Limited participated in Vision Summit 2026, held on 25–26 February 2026, bringing together technology leaders, innovators, and industry decision-makers from across the semiconductor and electronics sectors. The event served as a platform to discuss emerging technologies, industry collaboration, and the future of advanced electronics.

    At the summit, RRP Electronics showcased its semiconductor packaging capabilities highlighting its role in transforming semiconductor wafers into reliable chips used across industries. Visitors learned about the company’s OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) processes, including back grinding, wafer dicing, die bonding, wire bonding,molding, and final device packaging.


    A key highlight of the event was the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between RRP Electronics and HCL Tech. This strategic partnership combines RRP’s semiconductor packaging expertise with HCL Tech’s testing and validation capabilities to deliver an integrated end-to-end semiconductor service solution.


    The summit also provided an opportunity to engage with industry leaders and explore collaboration opportunities as the semiconductor sector continues to drive global technological innovation.

    RRP Electronics’ participation reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening India’s semiconductor ecosystem and supporting next-generation electronic technologies.

title: RRP Electronics at Davos 2026: Advancing Global Semiconductor and Telecom Partnerships
description:
RRP Electronics Limited participated in the global discussions and collaborations surrounding the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2026, held in Davos. The annual gathering brought together world leaders, policymakers, technology innovators, investors, and industry pioneers to discuss global economic trends, technological transformation, and strategies for building resilient industries.

    For RRP Electronics, Davos 2026 represented an important opportunity to engage with global stakeholders, present India’s growing semiconductor capabilities, and explore strategic partnerships that support the next phase of the company’s international growth.


    **Europe–India Cooperation Forum: Strengthening Cross-Border Collaboration**

    As part of its participation during the Davos week, RRP Electronics joined the Europe–India Cooperation Forum, an invitation-only platform designed to foster dialogue between European and Indian leaders on innovation, technology partnerships, and economic collaboration.

    Representing the company, Venkatesh Kumar contributed insights on how strategic capital allocation and strong leadership structures enable technology-driven manufacturing companies to scale across global markets.


    **Pre-WEF Engagements in Zurich**

    The journey to Davos began with a pre-WEF engagement in Zurich, where industry leaders and technology experts gathered for early discussions ahead of the official summit.


    **On-Ground Engagements at ET House**

    During the week of the World Economic Forum, the RRP Electronics team operated from ET House, Promenade 120 in Davos, engaging with global leaders, investors, policymakers, andn industry stakeholders.

    The discussions centered around several critical areas shaping the global semiconductor and advanced electronics sector:
    - Expansion of semiconductor manufacturing capabilities
    - Development of cross-border technology partnerships
    - Strengthening global supply-chain resilience
    - Building forward-integrated manufacturing models


    **Strategic MoU with Kleos for 5G+/6G Manufacturing in India**

    One of the major highlights of RRP Electronics’ presence during Davos week was the signing of a strategic Memorandum of Understanding with Kleos.
    
    The agreement was signed by Rajendra Chodankar and George El Aily, marking the culmination of over six months of technical evaluation and market analysis.

    The partnership aims to establish a state-of-the-art 5G+/6G manufacturing facility in India, combining:
    - RRP Electronics’ semiconductor manufacturing capabilities
    - Kleos’ advanced 5G+/6G Radio Access Network (RAN) technology

    The proposed platform will support next-generation applications such as autonomous mobility, UAV taxis, advanced IoT ecosystems, and other high-performance connectivity solutions.


    **MoU with JPS Technologies UK for Semiconductor Packaging Facility**

    RRP Electronics also announced another strategic international partnership during Davos week with JPS Technologies Ltd..

    The two companies signed a Memorandum of Understanding to establish an OSAT/ATMP semiconductor facility in Wales, United Kingdom. The proposed facility will replicate RRP Electronics’ proven semiconductor packaging operations in Mumbai and focus primarily on legacy semiconductor packaging, particularly for the automotive sector, where reliable semiconductor supply is increasingly critical.

    The partnership aims to::
    - Strengthen the United Kingdom’s semiconductor manufacturing capability
    - Improve supply-chain resilience in automotive and industrial sectors
    - Support the growing semiconductor ecosystem across the UK and Europe
    - Enable knowledge transfer, skills development, and innovation


    **Leadership Dialogue at WIN Lounge**

    During Davos week, Apoorva Raut represented the company at the second edition of the Women Inspiring Network Lounge.

    Ms. Raut participated in a panel discussion titled “Future of Capital: Funding Inclusive Innovation and Purpose-Led Ventures.” The session focused on how global capital flows can be reimagined to support equitable innovation, sustainable enterprises, and purpose-driven growth models.


    **Showcasing India’s Semiconductor Progress**

    During Davos 2026, Mr. Rajendra Chodankar also shared insights about RRP Electronics’ semiconductor journey in a conversation at the CNBCTV18 studios.

title: VLSID 2026: RRP Electronics Showcases India’s Semiconductor Momentum
description:
RRP Electronics Limited played a significant role at VLSID 2026, one of the most prominent conferences in the semiconductor and embedded systems industry. The 39th edition of the conference was held from January 3rd to 7th, 2026, at JW Marriott Pune, bringing together global technology leaders, policymakers, researchers, startups, and students from across the semiconductor ecosystem.

    With the theme “Global Synergy in Silicon: VLSID and Embedded AI for Sustainable Computing and Next-Gen Electrified Mobility,” the conference created a platform for discussions on cutting-edge semiconductor technologies, artificial intelligence integration, sustainable computing, and the future of mobility.

    **Mr. Rajendra Chodankar – Founder and Chairman of RRP Electronics Limited Delivers Visionary Keynote**

    A defining moment for RRP Electronics at the conference was the keynote address delivered by Mr. Rajendra Chodankar, who headlined the inauguration of the conference with his vision address titled “Closing the Silicon Loop: India’s Journey from Wafer Fabrication to Finished Chips.”

    During his keynote, Mr. Chodankar presented a comprehensive roadmap for strengthening India’s semiconductor ecosystem and highlighted the importance of developing indigenous capabilities across the entire value chain. He emphasized the need for India to move beyond design capabilities and establish strong domestic infrastructure for semiconductor packaging, testing, and manufacturing.

    He also spoke about the growing role of AI integration and sustainable mobility technologies, stressing that collaboration between global expertise and local innovation will be crucial in accelerating India’s semiconductor ambitions. His address set the tone for the conference’s discussions on building a self-reliant technology ecosystem and strengthening India’s position in the global semiconductor landscape.

    **RRP Electronics Powers VLSID 2026 as Main Sponsor**

    RRP Electronics Limited proudly supported the conference as a main sponsor, reinforcing the company’s commitment to advancing India’s semiconductor ecosystem. The sponsorship enabled key sessions, networking platforms, and knowledge exchanges that brought together innovators, policymakers, and academic researchers.

    By supporting VLSID 2026, RRP Electronics highlighted its dedication to strengthening collaboration across the semiconductor value chain and contributing to the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat. During the event, Mr. Chodankar reiterated the importance of developing domestic semiconductor capabilities, noting that India must build an integrated ecosystem that spans from wafer processing to finished semiconductor devices.

    **Launch of ‘Samved’ Fingerprint Sensor Modules**

    Another major highlight of the conference was the launch of Samved Fingerprint Sensor Modules, marking RRP Electronics’ strategic step into product-led innovation in biometric hardware.

    The Samved modules are designed with 508 DPI capacitive sensing technology, along with patented noise-suppression technology to ensure accurate and reliable biometric authentication. Available in both compact and large-area variants, these modules are designed to support a wide range of applications including identity authentication, secure access systems, and digital infrastructure.

    **CTO - Ms. Apoorva Raut Participates in Industry Panel**

    The second day of the conference continued the momentum with thought-provoking discussions on India’s semiconductor future. One of the key sessions featured Ms. Apoorva Raut, who participated in the panel discussion titled “Swadeshi to Silicon: Advancing India’s Product-Led Semiconductor Future.”

    The panel brought together industry leaders, technology experts, and ecosystem stakeholders to discuss how India can transition from design-focused capabilities to product-led semiconductor manufacturing. Conversations focused on strengthening domestic innovation, enabling manufacturing infrastructure, and encouraging collaboration between industry, academia, and government.

    During the discussion, Ms. Raut highlighted the importance of building strong product ecosystems in India and emphasized the need to nurture local design and manufacturing capabilities to compete globally.

title: Our Experience at Semicon 2025
description:
From 2nd to 4th September 2025, our team had the privilege of being part of Semicon 2025 in Delhi—a landmark event for the global semiconductor community.

    The atmosphere was buzzing with innovation, ideas, and collaboration. We were excited to showcase our capabilities in semiconductor device packaging and OSAT services, and it was amazing to see the interest and appreciation from industry experts and visitors alike.

    One of the biggest highlights for us was the signing of four Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) during the event. These agreements mark an important step forward in:
    - Strengthening India's domestic semiconductor ecosystem.
    - Building global collaborations.
    - Helping position India as a trusted hub for semiconductor manufacturing.

    Beyond the official announcements, what truly made the event special was the interaction with industry leaders, innovators, and policymakers. The discussions were inspiring and gave us new perspectives on where the industry is heading and how we can contribute to it.

    Overall, Semicon 2025 was not just an exhibition for us—it was an opportunity to learn, connect and grow. We came back with fresh ideas, stronger collaborations, and even more confidence in our mission to support India's semiconductor journey.

title: RRP Electronics at IESA Vision Summit 2025 – Gujarat
description:
In March 2025, the IESA Vision Summit 2025 in Gujarat marked an important milestone in India’s journey to becoming a global leader in semiconductors and electronics. Inaugurated by Shri Bhupendra Patel, Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, the event reinforced the government’s strong commitment to accelerating the ESDM sector and driving innovation in semiconductor manufacturing.

    We at RRP Electronics were proud to showcase our chip manufacturing capabilities to the Hon’ble Chief Minister. The summit witnessed an overwhelming footfall of distinguished delegates, semiconductor experts, industry vendors, and technology enthusiasts, reflecting the industry’s growing momentum and collective vision.

    A highlight of the summit was the keynote address by our Chairman & CEO, Mr. Rajendra Chodankar, who shared insights on the journey towards Maharashtra’s first semiconductor plant, along with our strategic partnerships, recent collaborations, and future roadmap. His vision and thought leadership sparked impactful conversations about the role of Indian companies in shaping the global semiconductor industry.

    As the summit came to a close, we reflected on three days filled with insightful discussions, innovation showcases, and valuable collaborations.

    The enthusiasm and active participation from across the ecosystem reaffirmed one thing: India’s semiconductor revolution is well underway—and RRP Electronics is proud to be at the heart of it.

title: RRP Electronics at ET Expo 2025
description:
In February 2025, RRP Electronics proudly participated in ET Expo 2025, a premier platform for showcasing innovations in Electronics and Automotive Electronics. The event brought together leaders, innovators, and technology experts to explore the future of electronics and mobility.

    We showcased our cutting-edge semiconductor innovations, highlighting how RRP Electronics is contributing to shaping India’s role in the global semiconductor landscape. A key highlight of the expo was the special session by our Founder & Chairman, Mr. Rajendra Chodankar, where he spoke about Maharashtra’s first Semiconductor OSAT Plant and the promising future of semiconductor technology in India.

    Raj Sir took the stage as a keynote speaker at the Automotive Electronics Conference 2025, sharing his vision on how semiconductors will drive the next wave of automotive technology and innovation. His insights resonated strongly with the audience, reinforcing RRP Electronics’ leadership in advancing both semiconductor manufacturing and automotive electronics.

    The event provided a fantastic opportunity for our team to connect with industry leaders, partners and innovators, fostering impactful discussions and collaborations that will help accelerate India’s electronics journey.

    ET Expo 2025 was a dynamic and enriching experience and we are proud to have represented RRP Electronics at a platform that is shaping the future of electronics and automotive innovation.
